title: Fresh blind groundwater boundary-interface information-carrier test
central_question: At equal one-scalar augmentation beyond G16 storage, does boundary-adjacent storage refinement or an explicit bottom-cell pressure-head shape moment better preserve the SWBOTB=5 prescribed-head boundary flux?

operator_contract.sign: native SWAP bottom flux; free drainage equilibrium is negative
operator_contract.primary_metric_domain: Only observations with active prescribed-head lower boundary (bottom_mode=5; RISE/FALL phases). HOLD observations use bottom_mode=2 and are excluded from boundary-interface estimator metrics.
operator_contract.hold_role: Execution/state integrity only; not scored by the P5C carrier comparison.

BASE16.h_state: Retention-inverted pressure head from mean theta over 157.5-160 cm.

SPLIT17.extra_scalar: Storage split of 157.5-160 cm at 158.75 cm.
SPLIT17.h_state: Retention-inverted pressure head from mean theta over 158.75-160 cm.
SPLIT17.K_state: K at that inferred lower-half head.

HM17.extra_scalar: Pressure-head first moment / linear slope within 157.5-160 cm.
HM17.h_state: h_bar from mean theta over 157.5-160 cm plus 0.625*g_h to estimate pressure head at 159.375 cm.
HM17.K_state: K evaluated at the estimated 159.375-cm pressure head.

FINE_ORACLE.role: operator sanity check only, not a reduced information candidate
FINE_ORACLE.h_state: Accepted Reference pressure head at bottom fine node.
FINE_ORACLE.K_state: K evaluated at accepted bottom fine-node head.

oracle_gate.requirement: On bottom_mode=5 observations only, the fine oracle must agree with Reference BOTTOM_FLUX to numerical roundoff/serialization scale and have zero sign mismatches before reduced-carrier results are interpretable.

candidate_metrics: mean absolute per-history signed bottom-flux bias cm/day

decision_policy.per_material_componentwise_noninferior: Candidate <= BASE16 for all three candidate metrics.
decision_policy.strict_gain: At least one candidate metric strictly lower than BASE16.
decision_policy.HYDRAULIC_SHAPE_SIGNAL: HM17 satisfies componentwise noninferior + strict gain separately for B01 and B14; SPLIT17 does not.
decision_policy.STORAGE_SPLIT_SIGNAL: SPLIT17 satisfies the rule separately for B01 and B14; HM17 does not.
decision_policy.BOTH_SIGNAL: Both satisfy the rule for both materials.
decision_policy.NO_ROBUST_SIGNAL: Neither satisfies the rule for both materials.
decision_policy.downstream_authority: A positive screen authorizes only a separately preregistered dynamic blind-validation phase for the selected carrier(s).

prohibited: reuse G17-G20 for the primary P5C decision
